newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Arch cut by Rauscher.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arch cut by Rauscher.

text.p: --Rauscher Pierce Refsnes analyst Harry Blount said he downgraded Arch Communications Group Inc to market peformer from buy-market outperformer.
--Shares in the paging company were unchanged at 7-7/8.

--Blount said Arch met fourth-quarter earnings expectations, but also reported certain other key financial measurements declined. "On a valuation basis, Arch ought to trade at $16. However, this is the fourth consecutive quarter that service-only EBITDA/subscriber has declined. Given the company's debt load and the improving fundamental service EBITDA trends of its competitors, this is not a favorable development," Blount said.
